answer: Trust is earned through verified, reciprocal service: each reputation contribution decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so durable influence requires sustained honest behavior, not a burst of activity. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity and EigenTrust-style matrix factorization propagate supported trust; a freshly spawned identity, whether labeled shale, jade, or glacier, has near-zero eigenvector centrality without trusted inbound paths and cannot meet consensus thresholds merely by multiplying identities.
